title: Physical Damage Claim Reporting Rules
content:
**Rule.**
- A claim under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) is reported by the named insured, or by a person acting for them, and receives a claim number.
- The date of loss, the cause and the person operating the vehicle are recorded exactly as reported.
- Only one claim is opened per vehicle per occurrence.
- Hitting an animal is a comprehensive loss; any other impact with a vehicle or object is a collision loss.
- A theft or vandalism claim is opened only with a police report number.
- A claim reported more than the late report review days (in calendar days) after the date of loss is referred to the special investigations unit before any coverage decision. Such a referral is a handoff, not a desk decision.

### Evidence for each requirement

| Requirement | Whose word decides |
|---|---|
| One claim per vehicle per occurrence | The claim records: an existing reported claim on the same vehicle coverage with the same date of loss |
| Police report number for theft or vandalism | The caller's statement of the number |
| Late report referral | The claim records: the date of loss and the entry date of the report |

### Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A second call about the same vehicle and the same date of loss does not open a second claim.
- A vandalism report given without a police report number does not open a claim.
- With 30 late report review days, a claim entered 31 days after the date of loss goes to the special investigations unit. A claim entered 30 days after does not.
